## Basic Rules of Probability (regardless of paradigm)
##### Bayes' Rule
$$
P(A|B) = \frac{P(B|A)P(A)}{P(B)} = \frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(B)}
$$

##### Union of Events
$$
P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A\cap B)
$$
##### Complement of Events
$$
P(A^c) = 1-P(A)
$$
